a.lede: A number of tech figures have backed an effort asking the AI chip giant to give Jensen Huang his job back.
a.title: Nvidia dismisses 'Bring Jensen Back' campaign as Trump backs effort to reinstate ex CEO

b.lede: A mob of tech bros is clamoring for Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO. It’s a bad idea.
b.title: Don’t Bring Jensen Back
